diffs.diff: temperature_C: datasheet reading gives 0.03125 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: MAX6675 datasheet (19-2235): '12-Bit, 0.25°C Resolution'; electrical table 'Resolution 0.25 °C'; 'Bits D14–D3 contain the converted temperature in the order of MSB to LSB.' The model encodes exactly this in sim.spiReplies (12-bit 'value' field, scale 0.25, after the D15 dummy bit and followed by D2 open-TC, D1 ID, D0) and the driver returns ((raw >> 3) & 0x0FFF) * 0.25. The second reading's 0.03125 is the same scale expressed per count of the whole 16-bit word: the temperature LSB sits at D3, so 0.25 / 2^3 = 0.03125 °C per raw-word count. Equivalent units, not a disagreement. The gate reports 'none' only because its conversion extractor reads sim.measure/sim.responses and not sim.spiReplies, so it never saw the model's 0.25 scale.
